whenToUse: Independent yes/no choices: consent, opt-ins, module selection.
Selecting several options from a small visible list (CheckboxGroup).
Row selection in tables and tri-state select-all.
avoidWhen: Exactly one of several options — use Radio Group.
Settings that apply immediately — use Switch.
Many options (>10) — use Combobox with multiple.
a11y: Every checkbox has a visible label; groups use a fieldset with a legend.
Indeterminate state is announced as mixed.
